license_declaration.product_identity_source: Paizo Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook, OGL §15 Product Identity section
license_declaration.product_identity_note: Named deities, NPCs, and unique places are Product Identity per the book's own OGL Section 15 declaration; core class/spell/equipment MECHANICS are Open Game Content.

screening_method_note: This book's 3400 records reached disk through TWO screening passes, and this note states both rather than implying one. PASS 1 -- cycle E2.0.6, 2026-07-27 -- covered the 3326 records then on disk (11 class, 2663 equipment, 652 spell): a heuristic first-pass screen of every `description` value against a bounded, documented term list (the 20 canonical core Golarion deities named in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's operating cycle brief), plus a broader capitalized-word frequency sample taken across those 3326 records during authoring to surface any other clearly-named NPC or Golarion place proper noun. PASS 2 covered the 74 records added on 2026-07-31 by `src/bin/ingest_races.rs` (7 race chassis + 67 standard racial traits): that binary runs a WIDER 54-term scan -- the same 20 deities plus 34 Golarion place and nation names -- over each record's `key`, `name` and `description`, and aborts the ingest with an error on any hit, so a record cannot reach disk unscreened; it does NOT run the capitalized-word frequency sample, which was a one-off authoring activity of pass 1. Zero matches were found in either pass for this book -- consistent with Paizo's own choice to keep the Core Rulebook's spell/equipment mechanical text setting-neutral. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan against 20 (pass 1) and 54 (pass 2) known names, and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what those scans can see.
known_open_item: A recurring cross-reference citation phrase, "Pathfinder RPG Bestiary" (a product-line-name citation appearing in several magic_items descriptions, e.g. efreeti_bottle, golem_manual_*), was found during sampling and deliberately NOT auto-redacted this pass -- it is a rules citation, not narrative PI content, and does not obviously fit the description-field PI bucket per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's own "ask, don't guess" instruction. Flagged here for operator review, not resolved.
